reader_start: The reader has the paper's title but has not yet been given the datum, maximal solution, or meaning of a finite smooth endpoint.
live_pressure: The early source contains roadmap prose, generic definitions, misplaced finite-energy exposition, theorem-catalogue cadence, and a Gold derivation that obscures the one missing estimate.

move.selection: Keep only definitions and historical results that make the regularity question, continuation threshold, present frontier, Gold estimate, or Silver reversal intelligible.
move.connection: Let each estimate expose the precise control it leaves missing, so the history generates Gold and Gold's difficulty generates Silver.
move.development: Develop the Sobolev continuation and critical concentration pictures fully, compress Gold to its proof shape, and preserve Silver's handwritten discovery order.
move.expression: Use direct human prose, ordinary causal verbs, equations only after their need is visible, and the approved opening exactly.

candidate_moves.reader_change: The reader can state what is known, what would continue the solution, what Gold still lacks, and what Silver proposes to test.
candidate_moves.next_possibility: Class membership can be introduced as the shared boundary reached from Gold and Silver.

sequence.thought: Fix the datum, viscosity, maximal solution, and exact target, then define only smoothness and maximal time.
sequence.connection: Those definitions make the historical estimates judgeable.
sequence.reader_start: No formal problem has been fixed.
sequence.reader_end: A finite endpoint has an exact meaning.

sequence.thought: Move from energy through vortex stretching, Sobolev continuation, critical concentration, and the present endpoint picture.
sequence.connection: The history narrows the unknown to one continuation-grade estimate.
sequence.reader_start: The reader knows what failure means.
sequence.reader_end: The reader knows what any finite failure must do and why energy leaves it open.

sequence.thought: State the exact Sobolev bound, explain briefly why it finishes the proof, and isolate the nonlinear estimate gap.
sequence.connection: The direct route's difficulty makes the reversed implication worth trying.
sequence.reader_start: The missing estimate has been located historically.
sequence.reader_end: The completed Gold proof and its missing step are both visible.

sequence.thought: Preserve the handwritten path from difficulty through the Gold assumption to the contrapositive and its many-case difficulty.
sequence.connection: The many cases create the need for one class-membership principle.
sequence.reader_start: The reader feels why Gold is difficult.
sequence.reader_end: The reader has discovered the Silver question before its formal name.

risks: Historical prose could flatten into equal theorem capsules.
One finite Sobolev bound could be described as if it literally contained every derivative.
Silver could lose its authored movement during cleanup.

choice_reason: Thomas fixed the subject order and the distinct depth of each movement; this realization preserves that order while repairing the reader's causal path through it.

evidence_dispositions.reason: Each technical name enters after the reader encounters the problem it answers.
The early subsections continue one accumulating question rather than restarting.
Historical results are connected by the control each leaves missing.
The solution, norms, derivatives, and estimates remain the grammatical actors.
Sobolev, criticality, Gold, and Silver are introduced only when needed.
Silver retains the order in which Thomas makes the reader discover the contrapositive.
Sentence form follows the causal move instead of polishing the old shell.
Conceptual turns use ordinary words before formal compression.
The Sobolev and frontier discussions continue until the reader can use them.
The peak and Zeno pictures remain inside the exact estimate limitation they illustrate.
The rewrite targets the actual early manuscript shell and Thomas's corrections.
This run creates manuscript prose rather than changing the reusable skill.
The reader performs the Silver reasoning before the formal method is named.
Silver remains an alternative proof logic rather than the paper's full proof closure.
Questions guide the movement without turning every hinge into a written question.
Every prose sentence must carry its own subject, action, and completed point.

uncertainties: The whole-space endpoint \(L^3\) results require explicit scope and should not be silently transferred to the periodic branch.
